messages.content: Hlo k xa
Namaste hajur! K sahayog chahiyo?
K hunxa tal

Hajur, ma Himal Organic Foods ko receptionist hu. Hami organic honey, dried fruits, spices ra herbal teas bechchhau — retail stores ra online delivery bata. Aaja Sunday bhayeko le store band cha; kun product ko jankari, price, or order ko sahayog chahanu huncha?
Sabai vanda derai sell hune kun product ho tapai ko

Hajur, yaha sales-ranking ko exact data chaina. Samanya roop ma hami ko raw Himalayan honey ra dried fruits (bises gari apricot) dherai popular huncha. Exact best-seller confirm garna cha bhane ma team sanga connect garidinchu? Maile hamro team lai pani janakari diye, tyesaile euta sacchai ko manche le tapailai follow-up garnecha.
Lala teo honey leu nata k garnu parxa

Hajur, raw Himalayan honey liyera kei kura dhyan dinu parchha: hamro honey ma added sugar ra preservatives hudainan, ra thik thau ma rakhyo vane shelf life practically indefinite huncha. Store garna cool, dry place ma, direct sunlight bata bachayera rakhnu hos. Honey crystallize bhae natural ho — thaplo paryo bhane jar lai garam paani ko bowl ma rakhera halka taap diye fherna saknuhunchha. Aru specific prayog ya dietary concern cha bhane bhannu hos, team sanga connect garidinchu.
Kasare kunne ho yes lai

Honey kasari khanu bhane: chhoto ma—tea ya herbal tea ma chini ko sato halnu, bread/roti ma spread jasto garnu, yogurt ya porridge ma topping banaunu, athawa taato paani ra ketaile lemon sanga milayera piunu saknuhunchha. Store garne tarika: cool, dry place ma rakhnu, crystallize bhaye jar lai garam paani ko bowl ma rakhera halko taaple pharkaunu. Kun recipe ya dietary concern cha bhane bhanuhos, ma team sanga connect garidinchu.
How to buy it vaneko k

Honey kinna sajilo cha — options: (1) Hamro Balkumari, Lalitpur retail store (Mon–Sat 9am–5pm) ma gae kinna sakincha (aaja Sunday bhayeko le band cha), (2) partner supermarkets jastai Bhat-Bhateni ra Big Mart ma pani paaincha, ra (3) home delivery hami ko website ra phone order bata available cha. K kun method chahanu huncha? Ma team sanga connect garidinchu bhane bhanuhos.
3 garam.nata

Hajur, "3 garam.nata" bhannu le ke bujhnu bhayo? Ke tapai 3 jar (250g/500g/1kg) kinla bhannai ho, ki 3 kg/3 sachet jasto kehi? Kun product (raw Himalayan honey, dried apricot, adi) ra kun purchase method (store / delivery / partner supermarket) chahanu huncha bhanera clear garidinu hos.
1 k g vaya hunxa ani home delivery garna milxa

Hajur, home delivery chai possible ho. Kathmandu Valley bhitra hamro delivery 1–2 business days ma huncha ra flat NPR 100 fee lagcha (order NPR 2,000 bhanda mathi bhaye free). Tara ma yaha stock ko thik size availability (1 kg) confirm garna sakdina — k tapai 1 kg jar ko availability confirm garna ra order place garna team sanga connect hunu huncha? Maile hamro team lai pani janakari diye, tyesaile euta sacchai ko manche le tapailai follow-up garnecha.
Hunxa
Thik cha — team le chito follow-up garnechan. Ke tapaiko phone number dinu huncha jasma hamro team le contact garos?
Thik cha — ke yo number (9823045928) ma hamro team le contact garna milcha? Kripaya delivery address pani pathaunuhos. Maile tapaiko contact information update gare.
Bode , Bhaktapur thimi

Thik cha — address bujhincha: Bode, Thimi, Bhaktapur. Yo thau Kathmandu Valley ko Bhaktapur bhitra parcha, so home delivery possible (1–2 business days). Delivery fee flat NPR 100 huncha; order NPR 2,000 bhanda mathi bhaye free huncha. K ma team sanga availability confirm garera order place garna tapailai connect garau?
Ok xata
Thik cha hajur — team le chito follow-up garnechan. Dhanyabad!
